text:
Maya Chen: Quick question — new hire started Jul 10. Summer office blackout Jul 15-19. They have a medical appointment Jul16 and only 8 hours PTO left. Can we prorate accrual and allow a 2-day carryover or convert to sick? Need manager + payroll steps.

Tom Lewis: We prorate accruals by start date. Medical carryover needs People Ops signoff + manager approval. Payroll cutoff is Jul 22.

Aisha Rahman: I’m the hiring manager — can approve conditionally. Could also shift time from on-call budget if needed.

Maya Chen: Two asks: 1) Prefer convert to sick (with doc note) vs temporary carryover? 2) How to record approval so payroll picks it up before cutoff?

hr-bot: See policy https://redwood.internal/hr/pto-policy (Accrual & Exceptions). Medical conversions require note and BambooHR comment.

Jen Soto: Manager should add a BambooHR comment tagging @people-ops. Payroll watches for tag #PTO-EXCEPTION. I’ll notify payroll.

Aisha Rahman: Added BambooHR comment: "Approve 2-day carryover Jul16-17 for medical; employee to submit note by Jul25."

Maya Chen: Employee to email medical note to hr@redwood.com (secure). I filed exception INC-ptocarry-19690 and added to PTO Exceptions - Jul. Once note is in, People Ops will mark days as carryover or convert to sick.

hr-bot: Policy note: if note not received by Jul25, carryover void and PTO must be used or paid out per policy.

Tom Lewis: Also log in monthly PTO exceptions sheet for finance forecasting.

Maya Chen: Action items: employee sends note, manager BambooHR comment (done), People Ops review, payroll picks up before Jul22.

Jen Soto: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
